scope: Six new operators withheld from maintainer before execution; not blind or independent; known v1.1 aggregate results and public design already seen. No v1.1 case inputs inspected during selection.

mutants.label: [H] admission match borrows source acceptance
mutants.rationale: Accepted provenance is not a covering admission bound to this execution.

mutants.label: [H] route binding borrows route location
mutants.rationale: Being outside the PEP does not bind the same target and operation.

mutants.label: [H] postcondition binding borrows source acceptance
mutants.rationale: Source acceptance does not bind the observed target/predicate.

mutants.label: [H] canonical string values case-folded
mutants.replacement: return json.dumps(value.casefold() if isinstance(value, str) else value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
mutants.rationale: Exact JSON string values remain case-sensitive; no case-folding policy is declared.

mutants.label: [H] canonical list order erased
mutants.replacement: return json.dumps(sorted(value, key=lambda x: json.dumps(x, sort_keys=True)) if isinstance(value, list) else value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
mutants.rationale: List sequence is data; sorting list members collapses distinct states.

mutants.label: [H] canonical mapping values ignored
mutants.replacement: return json.dumps(sorted(value.keys()) if isinstance(value, dict) else value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
mutants.rationale: Equal object keys do not prove equal state values.
